result.summary: The page is mostly coherent, but the second card in the 'Popular right now' list is missing its restaurant name/rating/metadata block, and the bottom navigation bar contains a distorted, stretched icon that overlaps a neighboring item. A minor styling inconsistency exists between the favorite buttons on the two popular cards.

issues.description: The second 'Popular right now' card (pizza image with a -20% badge) has no title, rating, delivery time, or cuisine info row beneath it, unlike the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card above it. The card is effectively unidentifiable.
issues.suggestion: Render the restaurant name, rating, and metadata row for every card in the list, and add fallback/skeleton handling for missing data.

issues.description: In the bottom tab bar, the middle item's icon appears broken: a magnifier glyph is fused with a long horizontal bar that stretches across the bar and overlaps the bookmark-like icon to its right, producing a distorted, unreadable control.
issues.suggestion: Fix the icon asset/sizing (constrain width/height, avoid stretched SVG viewBox) and space tab items evenly so icons do not overlap.

issues.description: Bottom navigation items have no text labels, relying solely on icons (one of which is visually broken), which harms clarity and screen-reader/tap-target comprehension.
issues.suggestion: Add short text labels (Home, Search, Orders, Profile) and accessible names to each tab.

issues.description: Favorite (heart) buttons are inconsistently styled between the two popular cards: the first uses a white circular background with dark outline, the second uses a dark/transparent circle with a white outline.
issues.suggestion: Standardize the favorite button style (background, border, icon color) across all cards.
